title: Sinewave signal plate
intent: Use the provided industrial graphic direction through scale, asymmetric massing and measured signal traces.
layout: A heavy two-line typographic block is balanced by a larger technical plot. Its horizontal axis continues into the dark transport, followed by synchronized spatial and text library views.

typography.rule: Oversized Montserrat fills the left mass with HarmonyOS Sans as the fallback. Blue marks the second line.
Use the same sans stack for labels. Use JetBrains Mono for axes, time, track numbers and numeric readings.

layers.role: Reference geometry for a scale-like scope face
layers.placement: Under the live signal with muted lines

layers.role: Time-domain waveform fed by current audio
Primary play, seek and monitor controls

constraints: Use neutral gray-white and black surfaces. Use blue for focus, selection and signal. Keep utility text clear of the trace and registration marks.
Preserve an equivalent list for spatial library selection.
Keep long titles inside the information column.

responsive.behavior: Stack the title, scope, transport and library. Reflow gain controls onto a second line.

motion: Display live analyser time-domain data during playback. Use a buffered sample during pause and reduced motion. The scrubber remains usable in all modes.
